h1: The 7 Best Nightstand Sets of 2 for Matching Bedsides, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Nightstand Set of 2 2026: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 7 nightstand sets of 2 compared on charging ports, drawers, load rating and warranty, from budget pairs to roomy tables.
summary: The LOAKEKEL Black LED set is the pair to buy for most bedrooms, with two outlets and USB-C on each table plus a lifetime warranty. The VASAGLE LIRY is the roomy, high-capacity choice for larger beds, the Furologee adds app-controlled lighting, and the LOAKEKEL 3-Tier is the cheapest way to get USB-C charging on both sides of the bed.
intro: Most people shop for a nightstand pair by color and then discover the footprint is the real problem. A table that looks generous in a staged photo can be 15 inches wide in your actual bedroom, and two of them flanking a queen bed leave less slack than you expect. The second surprise is power: a set that ships without outlets turns every phone charger into a cable that snakes down behind the headboard.

This ranking sorts seven matching pairs by what you will use every night. We reviewed each from its listing and spec sheet, focusing on footprint, built-in charging, drawer type, load rating and warranty. Where a maker does not state a number, we leave it out instead of guessing, and we score each pair as two tables bought together, not one.

products.name: LOAKEKEL Set of 2, Black, LED + USB-C
products.verdict: The most complete matched pair here, with charging, lighting and a lifetime warranty on both tables.
products.description:
This pair packs the full bedside kit into a 15.35 by 11.41 inch footprint, 23.3 inches tall. Each table carries a pair of wall outlets plus USB-A and USB-C ports, an RGB LED strip, and a four-tier layout that includes two fabric drawers. The frame is FSC wood with metal.

It ranks first because it is the only set in this ranking that combines a lifetime warranty with a full power strip and drawers. The Furologee below offers similar features, but its warranty is not stated, and that matters on furniture with electronics inside. The tradeoff is the small surface, so a lamp, a water glass and a book will crowd the top.

Buy it if you want a charging station on each side of the bed and dislike open clutter. Skip it if you want solid wood drawers, since the drawers here are fabric bins that suit socks and chargers better than heavy items.
pros: Lifetime warranty covers both tables
USB-C and two outlets on each side
Fabric drawers hide cables and clutter
RGB lighting works as a night light
cons: Fabric drawers will not hold heavy items
products.idealFor: Couples who want matching charging stations and drawer storage without a high price.
products.skipIf: You need a deep tabletop or true wood drawers.

products.name: VASAGLE LIRY Set of 2, Farmhouse, USB-C
products.verdict: The widest, sturdiest pair of the seven, built for beds that make small nightstands look silly.
products.description:
The LIRY set measures 17.7 by 15.7 inches at 23.6 inches tall, which is roughly two inches wider and four inches deeper than most rivals here. Each table offers dual outlets with USB-A and USB-C ports, a single drawer and an open shelf, and a stated 132 lb total load rating. The material is MDF, and it comes in two colorways.

It lands second because the footprint gives you a real tabletop, which is what most people actually miss on compact sets. It sits behind the LOAKEKEL only because it skips lighting and the lifetime warranty. The tradeoff is space: at nearly 18 inches wide, two tables need a bedroom with real elbow room on both sides.

Choose this if your bed is a queen or king and you want furniture that looks proportional. Skip it for a dorm or a narrow room where every inch counts.
pros: Largest tabletop in the ranking
132 lb load rating per table
USB-C and outlets on both tables
Two colorways suit different rooms
cons: Needs generous floor space beside the bed
products.idealFor: Larger bedrooms with a queen or king bed that need real surface area.
products.skipIf: Your room is narrow or you share a small space.

products.name: Furologee Set of 2, Black Oak, LED + Charging
products.verdict: App-controlled lighting and four charging points per table at a modest bracket.
products.description:
Furologee builds each table at 14.96 inches wide, 11 deep and 23.62 tall, with two outlets, two USB ports, app-controlled LED lighting and a 4.9 foot cord. Storage is two fabric drawers plus a two-tier open shelf, and the frame is particleboard with metal.

The lighting is what separates it from the pairs below, since you can change color and brightness from your phone instead of reaching for a remote. It ranks under the LOAKEKEL because the USB ports are listed generically, with no USB-C called out, and the warranty is not stated. The tradeoff there is that a newer phone may need an adapter, so check your cable before buying.

It suits renters and design-minded buyers who want a moody bedside. Skip it if you find app-controlled gadgets more annoying than helpful.
pros: App controls LED color and brightness
Four charging points on each table
Fabric drawers plus open shelf
Black oak finish hides dust well
products.idealFor: Renters who want a lit, tech-friendly bedside without spending much.
products.skipIf: You want a plain table with no app or lights.

products.name: LOAKEKEL Set of 2, Rustic Brown, 2 Drawers
products.verdict: The same charging core as the top pick, traded for a warmer finish and no lights.
products.description:
This set uses the same 15.35 by 11.41 inch footprint as the black model above, with dual outlets and both USB-A and USB-C per table. It adds a four-tier layout with two fabric drawers on each, a stain-resistant finish and the lifetime warranty.

It ranks below the black version only because it drops the lighting, and the rustic brown reads as farmhouse instead of modern. That is a style call, not a flaw, and for many bedrooms the plain finish is the better one. The tradeoff to keep in mind is that more tiers means shallower shelves, so tall items like a thick hardcover or a charging dock will not fit everywhere.

Buy it if you want the most storage inside the LOAKEKEL family. Skip it if you want a pair that doubles as a night light.
pros: Lifetime warranty on the full set
Stain-resistant finish wipes clean
Two drawers per table for cables
Warm rustic brown suits most rooms
products.idealFor: Buyers who want storage and charging in a warmer wood tone.
products.skipIf: You want LED lighting built into the tables.

products.name: Bonnlo White Nightstand Set of 2
products.verdict: A clean, quiet pair for buyers who want drawers that close softly and nothing plugged in.
products.description:
The Bonnlo pair measures 15.74 by 11.81 inches and stands 23.66 inches tall. Each table has two drawers with soft-close plastic stoppers, a waterproof surface and curved legs, and the stated capacity is 50 lb per table. The build is P2 MDF with wood, and there are no charging ports.

It ranks fifth for one reason: no built-in power. Every other set above it lets you charge a phone without a cord trailing to the wall, and that is a daily convenience you notice. The tradeoff is that the 50 lb rating is lower than the VASAGLE, so heavy lamps and stacks of books are better kept to a modest load.

Pick this if you already have a power strip behind the bed or care more about quiet drawers. Skip it if you charge three devices overnight.
pros: Soft-close drawers stay quiet at night
Waterproof surface handles spilled drinks
Curved legs look lighter in a room
White finish brightens small bedrooms
products.idealFor: Light sleepers who want silent drawers and a clean look.
products.skipIf: You rely on bedside charging for phones and devices.

products.name: HOOBRO Set of 2 End Tables, Rustic Brown
products.verdict: A charging pair with open shelves and adjustable feet, priced in the cheapest bracket.
products.description:
These tables measure 15 by 11 inches and 21.7 inches tall, a little shorter than the others. Each has one AC outlet, one USB-A and one USB-C port, two open shelf layers, a 4.9 foot cord and adjustable feet. The build is particleboard and metal.

The lower height and single outlet put it behind the LOAKEKEL sets, and with no drawers everything on the shelf stays visible. That is fine if you keep a tidy bedside and annoying if you do not. The adjustable feet are a real plus on uneven floors, since a wobbly nightstand is the most common complaint with lightweight furniture.

Choose it if you want USB-C charging and an airy look for little money. Skip it if you want to hide clutter or need the table to match a tall bed frame.
pros: Adjustable feet fix wobbly floors
USB-C port on each table
Open shelves make items easy to grab
Low price for a matched pair
cons: Lower height may not match tall beds
products.idealFor: Budget shoppers who want an open, tidy look with USB-C.
products.skipIf: You want drawers or a table above 22 inches.

products.name: LOAKEKEL Set of 2, Rustic Brown, 3-Tier
products.verdict: The cheapest route to USB-C charging on both sides of the bed, with a lifetime warranty.
products.description:
This is the stripped-down LOAKEKEL, at the same 15.35 by 11.41 inch footprint and 23.3 inches tall. It keeps dual outlets and both USB types on each table, but trims the layout to three tiers and one fabric drawer, in a stain-resistant, lightweight build.

It ranks last in this guide not because it is weak but because every other set here offers one more feature. You get less storage than the 2-drawer model and no lighting, and the lighter frame is easy to move but less planted than the VASAGLE. The lifetime warranty, however, is unusual in the cheapest bracket, and that counts for a lot.

Buy it for a guest room, a first apartment or a quick refresh. Skip it if the nightstand will hold your entire bedside routine.
pros: Lifetime warranty at the lowest price
Two outlets and USB-C included
Lightweight frame is easy to rearrange
Stain-resistant surface wipes clean
products.idealFor: Guest rooms and first apartments that need charging on a budget.
products.skipIf: You need more than one drawer of storage per side.

methodology.title: Footprint and height
methodology.description: We compared width, depth and height against typical bed and mattress dimensions, since a nightstand that sits well below the mattress edge is awkward to use.

methodology.title: Built-in power
methodology.description: Outlet count, USB-A and USB-C ports, and cord length were weighed together, because charging is the feature owners use most.

methodology.title: Storage design
methodology.description: Drawer type, shelf layout and stated load rating were scored for how well they hide clutter and carry real weight.

methodology.title: Materials and warranty
methodology.description: Particleboard, MDF, FSC wood and metal frames were compared along with any lifetime warranty, which signals how a maker stands behind the pair.

methodology.title: Value across the set
methodology.description: Features were measured against the $25 to $50 and $50 to $100 brackets, counting both tables as one purchase.

whatMatters.detail: A nightstand pair eats floor space on both sides of the bed, so a 15 inch wide table plus a 17 inch one is not interchangeable in a small room. Measure the gap between the bed frame and the wall, then leave about 24 inches of walking space. Compare the listed width and depth, not the product photo.

A good bedside sits within a few inches of the top of your mattress so you can reach it while lying down. The sets here run from 21.7 to 23.66 inches tall, which suits standard beds but can feel short beside a thick pillow-top. Check the table height against your mattress height, not the frame.

Outlets handle lamps and cords, while USB-C covers newer phones and USB-A covers older chargers. Count the ports per table, not per set, and confirm the cord length, since a 4.9 foot cord only reaches an outlet that is close. A strip with no USB-C means carrying an adapter, which defeats the point of a built-in station.

Fabric bins hide clutter cheaply but sag under weight, while soft-close drawers on rails run quiet and carry more. Open shelves are easier to grab from but show everything. Read the load rating, such as the 50 lb and 132 lb figures here, and treat it as a limit rather than a target.

Particleboard and MDF are normal at these prices, and edge sealing matters more than the name. Waterproof and stain-resistant surfaces handle spills better, and metal frames add stiffness. A written lifetime warranty is the best sign a maker trusts the build, so look for it on the listing.

faq.q: Will these nightstands fit next to a king bed?
faq.a: They will, but proportion matters more than fit. The VASAGLE LIRY at 17.7 inches wide looks right beside a king, while the 15 inch tables can look undersized. Measure the gap beside the frame before ordering.

faq.q: What is the most common mistake with nightstand sets?
faq.a: Ordering by finish and ignoring height. A table that sits well below your mattress edge forces you to reach down at night. Compare the listed height to your mattress top, not to the frame.

faq.q: Is the LOAKEKEL worth it over the HOOBRO?
faq.a: For most buyers, yes. The LOAKEKEL pairs add a second outlet, drawers and a lifetime warranty. The HOOBRO wins only on price and on the adjustable feet for uneven floors.

Expect about 30 to 60 minutes per table with a screwdriver, and have a helper for flipping the frame. Tighten bolts in a cross pattern and recheck them after a week, since particleboard furniture loosens slightly as it settles.

faq.q: How do I keep the built-in outlets safe?
faq.a: Plug in only what the table's power strip supports, and avoid space heaters or high-draw devices. Keep the cord clear of the bed frame so it is not pinched. If the unit has a cord, check that it reaches an outlet without stretching.

faq.q: Can I wipe down the surface?
faq.a: Yes, with a damp cloth. The Bonnlo's waterproof surface and the LOAKEKEL's stain-resistant finish handle spills best. Avoid soaking edges on particleboard, since moisture swells the core and ruins the finish.

finalTake: The LOAKEKEL Set of 2 in black with LED and USB-C is the best nightstand pair here, offering charging, drawers, lighting and a lifetime warranty in a compact footprint. The VASAGLE LIRY is the pick for large bedrooms, and the Furologee suits buyers who want app-controlled lighting. If you simply want working USB-C on both sides for the least money, the LOAKEKEL 3-Tier or the HOOBRO covers it. Measure your gap beside the bed first.
